entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-12
entry.content:
Issues

  • Validate certificate chain with custom trust root throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException #48899

Closed

  • ConfigureAwaitOptions_AsyncTaskMethodBuilderT&ConfiguredTaskAwaiter_The configuration issue of 'ConfigureAwaitOptions' option in the subsequent code after await #48418
  • Update (not in target) does not seem to work in Linux at latest (9.0.203) sdk. Windows is fine. #48900
